description: This file contains unit tests for generated heuristic decision classes related to mixed matrix multiplication (mixed_mm). It imports utility functions, defines test cases for two heuristics (A100 and H100), and validates the generated code snippets within these heuristics.

classes.name: TestMixedMM
classes.description: A unit test class for verifying the generated heuristic code snippets for mixed matrix multiplication heuristics.

methods.name: None test_mixedmm_a100(self)
methods.description: Tests the code snippet generated for the A100 heuristic by reading the generated file and comparing its contents with expected inline string.

methods.name: None test_mixedmm_h100(self)
methods.description: Tests the code snippet generated for the H100 heuristic by reading the generated file and comparing its contents with expected inline string.
